decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass packaging substrates build directly on the firm's established glass processing and packaging know-how, allowing it to interpret early results and improve the product, and its in-house R&D further supports learning.

Laser-based glass structuring for through-glass vias extends the firm's existing glass patterning and interconnect substrate expertise, and its own R&D and EU research cooperation strengthen its capacity to assimilate and commercialize this related technology.
